capabilities: Arrange today's tasks from the Daily Note and start one current task
Filter and organize active tasks, questions, and inbox notes in a Work Pool
Review and migrate unfinished work to the next day with a record in the previous note
Track ToThink/ToWrite annotations in an Open Questions sidebar
Journal completed, paused, and migrated work by day or month
disambiguation: Despite the name suggesting a writing or annotation tool, it is primarily a task-planning workbench over Markdown checkboxes.
extras: Desktop-only (isDesktopOnly: true). Optional AI, Trusted Backend, Device Hub/NFC, and local API features are off by default and send limited data when enabled; setup points to external Privacy/Security/Architecture docs.
problem: Obsidian's plain Markdown task checkboxes lack a dedicated workspace for planning, executing, migrating, and reviewing daily work and open questions.
summary: Desktop-only workbench that turns Markdown checkboxes, open questions, and inbox notes into a daily plan with Today, Work Pool, Journal, and focus views.
